snippet.title: Kiko's Apple Adventure release trailer | Thinky Direct 2025
snippet.description:
An adorable puzzle game about a curious bear who loves tasty apples. Explore islands, move the finish line, and outsmart your enemies.

Kiko's Apple Adventure, from PawPaw Games, releases today as part of the Thinky Direct 2025.

Kiko's Apple Adventure in the Thinky Games DB:
https://thinkygames.com/games/kikos-apple-adventure/

Kiko's Apple Adventure on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2916300/Kikos_Apple_Adventure/

More info about the Thinky Direct:
https://thinkgames.com/direct/
